history_summary: Record three native species-reference GTDB correspondences for the Brassica SynCom-NS descriptors.
history_details: The exact NCBI-ID routes reproduce Pseudomonas_E izuensis (five reference genomes, fraction 1.0), Ochrobactrum anthropi (100, rounded 0.94), and Novosphingobium lindaniclasticum (two, fraction 1.0). These are reference-taxon populations, not exact study-stock assemblies or measured abundance; no exact numerator is inferred from 0.94. Preserve canonical species labels, SaPI1/SaOA1/SaNL1 stock notes, Leifsonia's null/UNRESOLVED result, all source quotations and every biological field. Native label differences are database correspondences, not formal stock renaming. Only three GTDB blocks/statuses and two native inline events changed. Issue 2891 remains an explicit scientific blocker for the stored interaction types, member cross-feeding roles and directed host-mediator claims; this correction neither changes nor approves those claims. The pinned crosswalk's upstream release is unestablished. This bounded technical correction does not complete scientific review or corpus QC.
